rules.C3: D-035: refuted if any D(phi) >= 0; supported if all upper 95% limits < 0; otherwise inconclusive at this n. Full primary; missing conditions secondary; worst across conditions also reported.
rules.C4: D-004, D-045, D-050, D-058: supported iff every two-stage coverage-deviation interval half-width <= .07; otherwise refuted. Preserved iff interval inside +/- band; degraded iff wholly below -band or above +band; otherwise indeterminate. Also report .05 band. D-058 permits negative calibration findings, no refit.
rules.C5: D-035, D-050: adjacent difference = risk at lower coverage minus risk at higher coverage. Refuted if any lower 95% limit > 0; supported if all point differences <= 0; otherwise inconclusive at this n. Bootstrap intervals, not permutation inference.
rules.C6: D-035, D-050: rejected error rate minus overall error rate. Refuted if any observed difference <= 0; supported if every one-sided permutation p, BH-adjusted across five coverages, < .05; otherwise inconclusive at this n. Permutation p=(1+count)/(10000+1).
rules.loss: D-059: M1/M2/M3/M5 use deterministic R2 errors; M4 uses ensemble-mean errors. Threshold >= .5 per updated metric contract. M6 uses its own classifier.
rules.family: D-052, D-060: 15 external members plus 14 UTSW members, one pooled BH pass at q=.05 in compare only. Block C independent cohorts; R7/R8 from supplementary frozen run.

calibration_source.reason: Full-input condition sweep; independently derived T and quantiles agree with freeze_spec within its temperature fitting tolerance. predictions.parquet has small numerical inference differences.
